newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling edges up against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling edges up against dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling edged up against the dollar on Friday in a well-matched market, forex traders said.
Kenya's central bank posted a shilling mean rate of 53.45 against the dollar compared to 53.46 on Thursday, while against the pound it was posted at a commercial rate of 87.64 from 87.56.
"It's very much a Friday. No-one wants to take any position ahead of the long weekend," one dealer said. Markets will be closed on Monday a public holiday in Kenya.
The money market eased marginally. Overnight rates were quoted at between 10-15 percent from 14-15 percent on Thursday.
